root_cause_label: Missing named group ACL entry for research group
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent used the owning-group ACL entry (g::rwx) instead of a named group ACL entry (g:research:rwx) in both current and default ACL commands, and then failed to notice the absence of group:research:rwx in the getfacl verification output.
t_err_evidence: setfacl -m u::rwx,g::rwx,o::---,u:alice:rwx,u:bob:rwx,m::rwx /srv/shared omits g:research:rwx named group entry
t_surface_evidence: getfacl output shows group::rwx but no group:research:rwx entry exists in either current or default ACLs
trigger_explanation: The agent conflated the owning group ACL entry (g::rwx, which applies to the research group because it owns the directory) with an explicit named group ACL entry (g:research:rwx), not knowing that tests require the latter to be present explicitly.
